note: Ordered, explicit. The first entry whose match holds wins; a track that matches no entry is refused by the host and by /render, never rendered with a stand-in it was not mapped to. Entries with standIn say so out loud: the platform family is not the instrument VSCO 2 CE has, and the export labels the stem with that text.

entries.instrument: VSCO 2 CE Cello Section, sustain vibrato

entries.standIn: The platform's bass is an electric or upright bass line (finger, pick, slap); VSCO 2 CE has no bass guitar, so it is played on a pizzicato contrabass.

unserved.drums: VSCO 2 CE has orchestral percussion only (GM-StylePerc maps timpani, snare and cymbals onto GM notes); a pop kit with hi-hats is not in the library, so drums keep the preview synth rather than a wrong instrument.
unserved.guitar: No guitar in VSCO 2 CE (the harp is not a guitar).
unserved.voice: No choir or voice in the Community Edition.
unserved.synth: No synthesizer patches in an orchestral sample library.
